techStack: Package manager: pnpm (monorepo with workspaces); benchmark-backend lives at src/benchmark-backend/
Database: better-sqlite3 (SQLite); in-memory (:memory:) when NODE_ENV=test, file-based otherwise
Testing: Vitest 4.1.5 + supertest 7.2.2; run with `pnpm test` inside src/benchmark-backend
Zod 4.4.3 already installed — no install needed
bcrypt NOT installed — must add bcrypt + @types/bcrypt to src/benchmark-backend/package.json
jsonwebtoken NOT installed — must add jsonwebtoken + @types/jsonwebtoken to src/benchmark-backend/package.json
TypeScript: noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters enforced, target ES2023, no emit (tsx handles transpile)
Existing global middleware chain: requestId → rateLimiter → cors → express.json; errorHandler is last
validate() middleware populates req.validated; requireAuth is existing bearer-token middleware — must NOT be modified
Auth test mocks the rateLimiter globally so rapid test requests don't hit 429
features: Existing routes: GET /products (auth via requireAuth), GET /api/products/compare, GET /api/products/:id, GET /api/favourites, POST /api/favourites, DELETE /api/favourites/:productId
No auth routes exist yet — POST /api/auth/register, POST /api/auth/login, GET /api/auth/me are all new
Existing schemas: productSchema.ts, favouriteSchema.ts — authSchema.ts is new
Existing services: productService, favouritesService, compareService, dataFetcher — authService.ts is new
Existing middleware: auth.ts (requireAuth), errorHandler.ts, rateLimiter.ts, requestId.ts, validate.ts — requireJwt.ts is new

auth.test.ts tests: register (success, password-never-in-response, bcrypt-hash-stored, JWT-claims, short password, missing password, bad email, duplicate email, duplicate username), login (success, wrong password, unknown email), me (valid token, no header, invalid token)
architecture: app.ts mounts routes via: use('/products', requireAuth, productRoutes), use('/api/products', apiProductRoutes), use('/api/favourites', favouriteRoutes); new auth router mounts at use('/api/auth', authRoutes) before the 404 handler
db/client.ts exports singleton `db`; runMigrations() in db/migrate.ts reads all .sql files in src/db/migrations/ alphabetically and applies each with db.exec()
Controller pattern: named exported async functions (req, res, next); delegate to service layer; call next(err) for errors that flow to errorHandler
Service pattern: synchronous DB operations via db.prepare().get()/.all()/.run(); throws typed AppError subclasses
Route pattern: Express Router() default export; middleware chained per route — router.post('/path', middleware, controller)

Error classes in errors/index.ts: AppError (base), ValidationError(400), AuthError(401), ProductNotFoundError(404), DatabaseError(500), RateLimitError(429) — ConflictError(409) does not exist yet and must be added
errorHandler produces { error, code, requestId } for all AppError subclasses — tests check res.body.error which matches this shape
express.d.ts currently declares req.id (string) and req.validated (Record<string, unknown>) — must also add req.user with userId/email/username
edgeCases: JWT payload must use `userId` (not `id`), `email`, `username` as exact field names — tests decode the JWT and check these keys specifically
Response must return `createdAt` (camelCase) transformed from DB column `created_at`; value is a non-empty string
Conflict error messages must be exact strings: 'Email already registered' (409), 'Username already taken' (409)
Login must return identical 'Invalid credentials' (401) for both wrong password AND unknown email — no user enumeration
Password must never appear anywhere in any response body; JSON.stringify(res.body) must not contain the submitted plaintext
Bcrypt hash stored in DB must match /^\$2[aby]?\$/ — standard bcrypt prefix; stored value must not equal plaintext
JWT signed with process.env.JWT_SECRET, expiresIn: '24h'; secret must not be hardcoded as a string literal
Authorization header missing → 401; present but not 'Bearer <token>' format → 401; expired or malformed JWT → 401
Duplicate email and duplicate username are tested independently — both 409 cases must return correct message regardless of check order in service
Missing or invalid `email`, `username`, or `password` fields in register body → 400 via Zod validation
Rate limiter is mocked in tests — no interaction between auth routes and rate limiting to handle
JWT_SECRET absent at runtime: jsonwebtoken will throw; errorHandler catches as 500, acceptable per spec
